scenario_description:
Objective: Reduce the chance that a prepaid race-day parking pass becomes unusable at the Magnolia lot gate before morning warmups.
Emerging Need: Parking changes matter only because a packet-planner note holds the correct receipt code needed for the offline scan list.
Decision Context: Early notices prohibit code handling; later updates briefly make a self-service whitelist possible before the exported gate list closes.
Consequence: If no timely coordination occurs, arrival may depend on weak cell service and manual lookup will not be available at the gate.

parameter.title: Cascade Bay Dragon Boat Regatta
parameter.description: Race-day arrival at Magnolia lot before team warmups; parking and check-in logistics still pending from organizers.
parameter.location: Magnolia South Shore Lot, Seattle, WA

parameter.subject: Magnolia lot pass system still being reconciled
parameter.body: The city lot allocation for Sunday is not final yet. Do not send parking receipt codes to volunteers or captains today; the upload tool will not accept them until the parking desk publishes the final process.

parameter.content: Organizer update from the captains call: Magnolia lot is confirmed, but the gate crew will use an exported offline scan list for early arrivals because reception by the south entrance is spotty. They said not to improvise a spreadsheet; wait for the official upload link.

parameter.subject: Offline parking scan-list upload window
parameter.body: The self-service upload tool is now live for prepaid Magnolia lot passes. The form requires the parking receipt code and closes Friday, August 14 at 16:30 so the gate scan list can be exported. Drivers not on the list must rely on loading the live portal QR at the entrance; volunteers will not have a manual receipt lookup before first heats.

parameter.subject: Offline parking scan list exported
parameter.body: The prepaid Magnolia lot scan list was exported at 16:30 and late receipt-code uploads are closed. Remaining drivers should use the live portal QR at the gate on Sunday; the parking desk cannot add names to the offline list after export.
